description_en: Imports local data sources to a destination DataWorks workspace in batches
description_zh: 批量导入本地数据源至目标DataWorks工作空间
name: ImportDataSources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The array of data source configurations to be imported. The Name, DataSourceType, SubType, Description, Content, and EnvType parameters are required. For more information about the parameters, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211429.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 待导入数据源的数据源内容数组。其中Name，DataSourceType，SubType，Description，Content，EnvType参数为必填参数。参数的详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211429.html接口
parameters.name: data_sources

Data.description_en: The result of importing data sources in batches
Data.description_zh: 批量导入数据源的返回结果

Message.description_en: The description of the cause for the failure to import data sources in batches. If the data sources are successfully imported, this parameter is left empty
Message.description_zh: 批量导入数据源失败后的原因描述。如果批量导入数据源成功，则该参数的返回值为空
Message.example: Data source DEV XXX already exists

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether all data sources are successfully imported. Valid values:
true: All data sources are successfully imported.
false: Some data sources fail to be imported. You can check the Message parameter to locate the cause of the failure
Status.description_zh:
批量导入数据源的结果状态。取值如下：
true：表示全部数据源导入成功。
false：表示部分数据源导入失败，您可以查看Message参数定位失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败
